evaluation.summary: The Albanian version of the website has critical accessibility issues, including an incorrect HTML lang attribute and mixed Cyrillic and Latin script. recommendations: Correct the HTML lang attribute to 'sq' for the Albanian page.
Eliminate all mixed content, specifically translating or transliterating 'Е-furnizime' and ensuring all text is in Latin script.
Conduct a thorough proofread to correct typos (e.g., 'PROJECTE', double 'e') and ensure consistent grammatical forms (e.g., imperative verbs).
Translate all untranslated English phrases (e.g., 'Civic Initiative') and provide Albanian equivalents or explanations for acronyms (OSP, GIS, GUP) on first use.

items.focusIndicatorDescription: A blue outline appears around the 'Регистрирај се' link in the top right corner.
items.issue: The focus indicator, a blue outline around the 'Регистрирај се' link, has insufficient contrast against the red header background (contrast ratio approximately 2.1:1). WCAG 2.4.7 and 2.4.11 require a minimum contrast ratio of 3:1 for non-text components.
items.suggestion: Change the color of the focus indicator to ensure it has a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against the red background. Alternatively, use a more prominent focus style such as a thicker outline, a background highlight, or a different visual cue that meets the contrast requirements.

visualIssues: Hidden carousel navigation elements ('Previous', 'Next') overflow the viewport
items.suggestion: Ensure all content, including hidden or off-screen elements like carousel navigation, fits within the 320px viewport without causing horizontal scrolling. Adjust element sizing, visibility, or use appropriate CSS to prevent overflow.

issues: The last line of the main paragraph text ('сообраќајот') is clipped at the bottom of its container, making the full message unreadable.
items.suggestion: Ensure text containers are not fixed-height or can expand dynamically to accommodate increased text spacing. Use flexible box models or dynamic sizing for text blocks to prevent content clipping.

issues: Site does not adapt its colors for dark mode, displaying a light theme despite the user's 'prefers-color-scheme: dark' setting.
suggestions: Implement a dark mode theme using the `prefers-color-scheme: dark` media query to respect user preferences and improve accessibility for users who prefer or require dark interfaces.
